typography.$description: The --ff-text-* type roles, parsed out of their font shorthands: display through small, plus prompt. clamp() sizes are resolved at 1440 and the captured 390-px declarations ride in $extensions.responsive; tracking is the companion --ff-text-*-tracking var.

motion.$description: Motion as measured: the durations and easing curves the product's elements run, which properties transition, its animations and @keyframes, and what prefers-reduced-motion: reduce changes. Read by tools/capture/motion-probe.mjs.

800ms.$description: Declared in a state rule, not seen running at rest.

1200ms.$description: Declared in a state rule, not seen running at rest.

1400ms.$description: Declared in a state rule, not seen running at rest.

1700ms.$description: Declared in a state rule, not seen running at rest.

ease-2.$description: The keyword `ease`, expanded to its control points.

ease-out.$description: The keyword `ease-out`, expanded to its control points.

linear.$description: The keyword `linear`, expanded to its control points.

reducedMotion.probe: page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion }): 'no-preference' then 'reduce', same elements, same page
